title: Qwen3Clone-8B script forgot use_head_qk_norm — used per-channel QK norm instead of per-head
root_cause: build_model_config for Qwen3Clone-8B configured the Qwen3 model but did not set config.block.attention.use_head_qk_norm = True. Qwen3 uses per-head QK norm; the default per-channel QK norm was applied instead, normalizing across the wrong axis and producing different attention scores from the reference Qwen3.
invariant: Model factories that clone HF reference models must set every option that affects forward semantics to match the reference, including use_head_qk_norm for Qwen3.
diff_summary: Add config.block.attention.use_head_qk_norm = True after the Qwen3 builder in build_model_config.
silent_check: Training runs with no exception — QK norm is applied across the wrong dimension producing valid finite attention; the model trains but on a fundamentally different normalization than Qwen3 reference.
